comments.body: The Golden-mantled ground squirrel is brief and sporadic while the chipmunk is more repetitive. So it is more likely to be the ground squirrel.

Possibly a Golden-mantled ground squirrel. They look like a chipmunk but bigger. It doesn't sound like an American Red Squirrel. I am not an expert. I did some checking around for audio observation comparisons and I am still not convinced it is not a chipmunk.
